method: Read the installed NMS.exe offline; map old exported function/caller byte windows to unique positions in the updated PE; verify .pdata boundaries; decode E8 calls in the mapped parent with iced_x86 and compare each instruction offset and target with the prior 33-site inventory.
conclusion: The old bounded parent and its 33 E8 sites map coherently to the updated executable. Addresses from the earlier runtime event and code export must not be used as current-build runtime evidence.
limitations: This is an offline cross-build map. No new root event, dispatch-slot sample, or NMS gameplay validation was captured on the updated executable.
The mapped 006369F0 remains a byte-correlated position inside a function, not a proven indirect call destination.
The owner+0x10 field is distinct from the indirect caller [RDX+0x10] slot.
The helper target map identifies call destinations, not semantic function names.
next_step: Continue static helper and parent dataflow on this build. Prove the indirect destination with a live [RDX+0x10] sample from the current executable when the runtime capture can be run.
correction_20261007: The mapped 006369F0 is an old evidence-label byte location, not the current hook signature. Current signature uniquely matches 0063A6D0; see NEW_ROOT_CAPTURE_REVIEW_20261007.json.
